title.zh-CN: 外部效度检验用结构骨架（题干已移除）

description.zh-CN: 由一份真实专业问卷转写而来的结构骨架：保留点数、极性、构念分组、反向计分标记、选项数量与矩阵行数，题干与选项文案一律替换为占位符。来源与完整分析见 docs/external-validity-check.md。

generation_provenance.derived_from: a real professional instrument, transcribed then stripped of its prose
generation_provenance.note_on_construct_names: Construct names and ids are our own modelling labels for the instrument's visible groupings; the source ships no construct table. They are not third-party prose.
generation_provenance.status: PRIMARY ARTIFACT - maintained by hand, no longer derived
generation_provenance.why: This file used to be generated from a local, git-ignored transcription. That made a committed 1787-line artifact that CI depends on unreproducible the moment the local source was lost. The derivation is terminated: edit this file directly. The original generator is kept only as a historical record of how the structure was first extracted.
generation_provenance.editing: Hand-edit. Keep the scale shapes intact - 8 items at points=11/min_value=0, 19 at points=4, 12 at points=5 - because the external-validity counts in tests/test_survey_external_validity.py are asserted against them.
